text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's the final G1 race of spring—the<n>Takarazuka
Kinen! Which one of<n>these fine competitors will
cross the<n>finish line first?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Each and every one of these<n>Umamusume carry
the hopes of their<n>fans on their shoulders... and
here<n>they come to the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The venue for the Takarazuka Kinen<n>is the Hanshin
Racecourse, as<n>scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We have a final meeting in the waiting<n>room to
wrap up some loose ends<n>before the race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's go over some things.<n>Were you able to
get data on the<n>other runners, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Excellent. Let's look over them while<n>we—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, not at all. This is... amazing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You even have data on their training<n>methods here.
Looking at this, it<n>seems like it will be an intense
race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, the runner-up of the pre-race<n>favorite poll will
likely pull away at the<n>third turn, so I should be
ready by the<n>second turn. And...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The data I collected prove helpful, and<n>we have a
very productive meeting<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Give it up for the grand winner of our<n>pre-race
favorite poll!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's right! And I'm about to prove<n>to everyone
who voted for me that<n>they picked the winning
racer!
